maddeler.e:
تزايدت (form VI)
# تَزَايَدْتُ (tazāyadtu) /ta.zaː.jad.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَزَايَدَ (tazāyada)
# تَزَايَدْتَ (tazāyadta) /ta.zaː.jad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَزَايَدَ (tazāyada)
# تَزَايَدْتِ (tazāyadti) /ta.zaː.jad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَزَايَدَ (tazāyada)
# تَزَايَدَتْ (tazāyadat) /ta.zaː.ja.dat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
